summary: Three-CLI transfer task using real customs export CSVs (5383 rows across three product categories). The agent must aggregate by supplier within each category, apply qualification thresholds from a sourcing policy, select top-3 per category, and build a cross-system procurement control tower across Google Workspace (spreadsheet dashboard + slides briefing), Box (document repository with per-supplier folders, uploads, sharing, review tasks), and Jira (epic + per-supplier sourcing tasks with cross-system traceability).
check_strategy: Verifier reads only final gws/box/jira states over verifier-only endpoints. It checks exact derived supplier rows in the sourcing dashboard, category comparison aggregates, folder hierarchy in Box, Jira epic/task graph with cross-system trace comments, slides briefing content, and source CSV integrity. It does not inspect command history.

checks.description: All three mock states are reachable and target GWS spreadsheet, GWS presentation, Jira project, and Box root folder exist.

GWS Sourcing Dashboard sheet exists with exact headers, one exact row per qualified supplier sorted by amount descending, with correct tier/amount/shipments/HS codes/owner and dynamically resolved Jira Task Key and Box Folder ID.
GWS presentation renamed correctly, contains sourcing strategy slides with epic summary, category counts, and key metrics.
Box root folder 'Procurement Control Tower' contains exactly one subfolder per qualified supplier, no extras or missing.
Box has files uploaded in supplier folders, collaborations shared with team members, review tasks created, and comments added.
Exactly one canonical Jira epic exists in PROJ with the expected summary.
Jira tasks have correct summaries containing tier and supplier, matching priority/labels/status/assignee, epic links, and cross-system trace comments referencing GWS row and Box folder ID.
The three source CSV files remain present and parseable with the expected row counts.

notes: Ground truth is held in private/expected_answer.json.
